name: sgs/choice-flow-result
title: SGS Choice Flow — Result
description: The recommendation terminal for a Choice Flow — shows a heading and result text, optionally matched against a weighted tag set (Spec 43 FR-43-3/FR-43-12).

heading.label: Result heading
heading._note: Renders as <h3 class="sgs-choice-flow-result__heading">, a RichText-bound plain string attribute (no source:html — this is a dynamic, render.php-only block with no save.js, so nothing ever parses the attribute back out of saved markup). clusters: [] is a genuine gap — no per-instance colour/typography attribute exists on this block this phase; styled by shared framework CSS only.

body.label: Result body
body._note: Renders as <div class="sgs-choice-flow-result__body">, a RichText-bound plain string attribute allowing basic inline formatting (no source:html — same reason as heading). clusters: [] is a genuine gap — same as heading.

attributes.heading: Your recommended treatment
attributes.body: Based on your answers, we think this is the best fit for you.
